positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Reduced the number of bugs in the software by working closely with our back office department
•	Developed new features to increase user activity through ease of use with the website
•	Tested and reviewed code to improve the quality of the software
•	Decreased unstructured code by condensing complex statements into easy to understand functions that satisfied business requirements
•	Expanded our userbase by integrating with Doximity and contributing to building a mass user upload and matching system
•	Integrated with Twilio to deliver scheduled SMS messages that led to less calls about patients not going to scheduled appointments
•	Collaborated with designers and staff to ensure a clean interface
•	Safely worked with client’s patient (PHI) data that had to be encrypted
•	Able to be offsite and communicate with other employees, either offsite or in different time zones
•	Introduced an automated self-pay system using Stripe which lead to more paying customers and more productivity for out sales and accounting team
